Main fail nahi—bas 10,000 tareeke mile jo nahi kaam kare.
Darr ek pratikriya hai, par himmat ek faisla hai.
Grit tumhari pehchan banati hai.
Grit growth ke liye jagah banata.
Grit vijeta ko paribhashit karti hai.
Narmi jiska na sah sake, taqat sah leti.
Sabse mushkil hai act karne ka faisla; baaki sab bas tenacity hai.
Jo hansne se dar ko jeet le, wahi sahaswala hai.
Himmat ek kadam se shuru hoti hai.
Kabhi kabhi silence bhi battle hota hai.
Sabse badi shaan kabhi na girna nahi, balki har girne ke baad uthna hai.
Grit luck nahi—practice hai.
Khamoshi gehri hoti hai.
Grit believe karta: aap kar sakte.
Himmat rooh ka paimana hai.
Grit surrender se mana karta.
Himmat contagious kindness hai.
Himmat power ki shuruaat hai.
Bravery hai, being the only one who knows you're afraid.
